title: Niagara Night Tour with Boat, Skylon Tower & Behind the Falls
includes: Admission to Niagara City Cruises (May - December)
Seasonal Boat Replacement: Niagara Takes Flight Ride (January - April)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Niagara Falls after dark on this immersive small-group walking tour. Begin with a scenic stroll along the Niagara Parkway before boarding a Niagara City Cruises boat for an unforgettable ride to the base of the Falls.

Continue your journey with visits to iconic viewpoints, including the American Falls and Horseshoe Falls, beautifully illuminated at night. Explore the tunnels at Journey Behind the Falls and feel the power of the cascading water up close.

End your experience with a visit to the Skylon Tower, where you’ll take in breathtaking panoramic views of the illuminated Falls and surrounding skyline. This tour combines Niagara’s top attractions into one unforgettable evening experience.
